name: book-epub-project-ja-zh-hans

scripts.release:draft: npm run preflight:template && npm run cover:check && npm run reader:check && python scripts/create_release.py --status DRAFT
scripts.release:create: npm run preflight:template && npm run cover:check && npm run reader:check && npm run review:random-validate:pass && python scripts/create_release.py --status PASS --require-pass
scripts.build:epub: npm run preflight:template && npm run lint:publication && npm run lint:assets && npm run cover:check && node scripts/build_epub.js && npm run build:bilingual && npm run reader:check

description: Book-local npm scripts for Japanese to Simplified Chinese EPUB production. Shared Node dependencies are installed once under books/node_modules and are resolved by walking up from the project root.
